rca of the issue: NewTaskDialog.jsx appears to be the product of a partial / incomplete edit by main agent: (1) Lines 81-175 are the correct new component body that adds the AI-suggest banner with data-testid='ai-suggest-banner' and data-testid='ai-suggest-btn', but it references aiBusy/aiSuggested/reRunAI which were never added as state/handlers (likely the state declaration block was forgotten). (2) Lines 176-202 are a leftover duplicate fragment from the pre-edit version of the JSX (status select + folder select + create button) that was not deleted, causing Babel parser error 'Adjacent JSX elements must be wrapped in an enclosing tag (185:10)'. Mitigation: main agent must (a) delete lines 176-202 entirely, (b) add `const [aiBusy, setAiBusy] = useState(false); const [aiSuggested, setAiSuggested] = useState(false);` near the other useState calls, (c) define reRunAI = async () => { setAiBusy(true); try { const { data } = await api.post('/ai/extract-task', { message_body: sourceMessage.body, message_id: sourceMessage.id, chat_id: sourceChatId }); setTitle(data.title); setDescription(data.description); setPriority(data.priority); if (data.suggested_assignee_id) setAssignedTo(data.suggested_assignee_id); setAiSuggested(true); } finally { setAiBusy(false); } }, (d) call reRunAI() inside the existing useEffect when `open && sourceMessage` is truthy.
